title: WabbleSpec Project Map Contract
description: Contract schema for .wabblespec/state/plans/project-map.md. Markdown — Guard Layer 1 validates by field-name presence in the markdown body. Full JSON validation applies only if project-map is serialised as JSON. freshness_state and valid_until are required — a map without them cannot be used as a reference slice by ReferenceLoad.

explored_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when Explore wrote this map.

build_target.description: Build target from recipe.json. Must match a declared L3 platform module.

freshness_state.description: FRESH: within valid_until window. AGING: 24–72h past explored_at. STALE: 72h+ elapsed or structural change detected (entry-points changed, new packages added). EXPIRED: entry-points or tech-stack changed in git — requires Explore re-run before any module may consume this map.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which freshness_state transitions to AGING. Default: 24h from explored_at. High-churn projects may set this lower.

entry_points.description: Primary entry point file paths. At least one required — absence of an entry point means Explore did not complete.

area.description: Functional area (e.g. runtime, database, framework, build, test).

confidence.description: exact: read from manifest lock file. inferred: read from manifest without lock. assumed: no manifest evidence.

tech_stack.description: Detected technologies. confidence field prevents downstream modules from trusting assumed stack entries.

risk_reason.description: high-churn: modified in >3 of last 30 commits. edit-warning: file has an explicit annotation warning against edits. no-tests: no test file references this path. cross-cutting: imported by >5 other modules.

churn_count.description: Number of commits modifying this file in the last 30.

risk_files.description: Files warranting extra care before editing. Executor and Guard use this list to apply heightened receipt requirements to waves touching risk files.

primary_paths.description: Ranked file paths for this slice. Index 0 is highest priority.

test_paths.description: Test files covering primary_paths in this slice.

reason.description: Why this slice is named — what question it answers.

impact_slices.description: Named map slices keyed by slice name (e.g. 'entry-points', 'api-surface', 'test-coverage', 'risk', 'conventions'). ReferenceLoad consumes named slices instead of raw file trees. A module asking about 'api-surface' loads only that slice, not the full project-map.

spec_artifacts.description: Spec artifacts found during traversal (task-cards, scope.md, receipts, wave plans).

conventions.description: Observed naming conventions, project structure patterns, and architectural patterns.

recent_changes.description: Files modified in last N commits.

gaps.description: Areas Explore could not determine. At least one required — prevents false completeness claims. Each gap entry blocks any module from assuming coverage of that area without a new Explore run.

$comment: Guard Layer 1 validates markdown project-map.md by checking presence of: explored_at, build_target, freshness_state, valid_until, entry_points (>=1 item), Tech Stack section (>=1 row), Risk Files section, Impact Slices section (>=1 named slice), Gaps section (>=1 item). ReferenceLoad gate: freshness_state EXPIRED blocks all slice consumption — ReferenceLoad must trigger Explore re-run before loading. Executor gate: risk_files list feeds heightened wave-receipt requirements for waves touching listed paths. Schema: .wabblespec/engine/shared/schemas/project-map.schema.json.
